PIECE R3-ASM — THE ASSEMBLY AT PALM LEVEL
(round-3 design item (4), lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:3807-3818)
Grade: PROVED-WITH-TYPED-GAPS. The Palm-cycle row (ASM-PALM) and the
pathwise domination lemma (LEM-LABEL) are proved outright; the margin
arithmetic is exact and independently recomputed in BOTH regimes; the
passage to R5a's round stays TYPED as DELTA-PE1-ENTRANCE and
DELTA-PE1-DELAYED, which R3-PE3p owns.
========================================================================

------------------------------------------------------------------------
0. WHAT THIS PIECE DELIVERS
------------------------------------------------------------------------
On OBJECT-PE1 (the PLAIN Palm S-return cycle), with
   B_k := {w_theta = k} INTERSECT ( {E_eps >= S_k + c_H} UNION {w_phi != 0} ),
   err := eps w_k + L_eps N delta^2/16 ,
   T(N,delta) := (1/4) N delta^2 V_M (2/delta)^{2N}   (beta-free),

 (ASM-PALM)  E_{Palm}^{pl}[ V_{B_k} ]
             <= T(N,delta) . beta . exp( -beta ( min( S_k + c_H - m_k ,
                                          m_1(lambda) ) - err ) ),

and, with 2 mu := min(S_k + c_H - m_k, m_1(lambda)) - err - c_H/2 > 0
(Section 8), the same quantity is <= [T(N,delta)/(e mu)] exp(-beta c_H/2),
i.e. the PARENT row's literal shape with a beta-FREE prefactor and NO
err(delta) left in the exponent.

 (LEM-LABEL) PATHWISE, on R5a's round i: w_theta = k identically on
             [sigma_{i-1}, T_i), hence the round's occupation of M \ R_0
             equals its occupation of B_k up to a Delta_theta set of zero
             expected duration; and [sigma_{i-1}, T_i) SUBSET
             [sigma_{i-1}, D(sigma_{i-1})), so that occupation is at most
             the delayed cycle's occupation of B_k.

NOT delivered: any per-ROUND expectation. (ASM-PALM) rides OBJECT-PE1;
the round rides OBJECT-R5a. The two transfers are typed, not closed.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. OBJECTS — FIVE, NAMED ONCE, NEVER CONFLATED
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Standing, verbatim: "dX_t = -grad E_eps(X_t) dt + sqrt(2/beta) dW_t on
M = T^{2N}, flagship k=1, N>=10, M2-PIN (lambda>kappa), eps in [0, eps_2)
fixed" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3001]. Filtration, verbatim: "Let
(F_t)_{t>=0} be the augmented natural filtration of the diffusion X,
F_t := sigma(X_{s} : s <= t) completed and made right-continuous. ...
theta^+(.), D(.), the sigma_i, and the crossing time (§4) are all hitting
times of Borel sets by the continuous process X, hence (F_t)-stopping
times; F_{sigma_{i-1}} is the corresponding stopped sigma-field. Because
the SDE is autonomous, the strong Markov property holds at each
sigma_{i-1}" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3035]. Balls: "S := B_{delta/4}(g*)"
and "S^+ := B_{delta/2}(g*)" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3008-3009].

 O1  COLLAR EXIT   theta^+(t) := inf{ s >= t : X_s not in S^+ }
     [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3015].
 O2  DELAYED RETURN  D(t) := inf{ s >= theta^+(t) : X_s in S }
     [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3016]. DELAYED CYCLE from an S-entrance
     T_0: the interval [T_0, D(T_0)).
 O3  PLAIN S-RETURN CYCLE = OBJECT-PE1, verbatim: "OBJECT-PE1: the PLAIN
     S-return cycle {T_0, T_1} of the AUTONOMOUS diffusion with NO
     absorbing theta-label event, started from the cycle-stationary
     (Palm) entrance law rho_S^Palm on S. Its expectation operator is
     E_{Palm}; its per-cycle occupation is V_B; its cycle length C is the
     UNCONDITIONED plain-return length (finite by (INT), beta-dependent,
     = 1/lambda_S)" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1936-1940]. I write
     E_{Palm}^{pl} for its Palm expectation and N^{pl} for the stationary
     point process of plain S-return cycle-start epochs whose Palm law it
     is. NO E_{Palm} appears below without a superscript naming its
     cycle-start point process.
 O4  DELAYED PALM CYCLE = OBJECT-PE1-DELAYED: the regeneration
     {D(sigma_{i-1})} with "its own Palm entrance law and entrance
     intensity lambda_S^{delayed}" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:2198].
     Expectation E_{Palm}^{del}. A DIFFERENT Palm object; SR-PE1 does NOT
     supply (KAC-OCC)/(KAC-RATIO) on it.
 O5  R5a ROUND = OBJECT-R5a: [sigma_{i-1}, T_i), "T_i := min(
     D(sigma_{i-1}) , L_i )" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3048],
     "L_i := inf{ s > sigma_{i-1} : w_theta(X_s) != k }   (the first
     theta-label change after the round start)"
     [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3044], round-start law verbatim: "There is
     no fixed regeneration law nu here: X_{sigma_{i-1}} is an arbitrary
     (F_{sigma_{i-1}}-measurable) point of S"
     [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3037]. Its expectation operator is
     E( . | F_{sigma_{i-1}} ), the stopped sigma-field of §3.

Levels: "e_0 := M_k(eps) = m_k + eps w_k", "m_k := kappa N(1 - cos
(2 pi k/N))", "w_k := W*(G_k) = N(1 - cos(2 pi k/N))"
[lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:1377-1378]; g(N) := N(1-cos(2 pi/N)), so at
k=1, kappa=1: m_k = g(N), w_k = g(N), m_1(lambda) = lambda g(N).
Band, verbatim: "c_H := (1/4) min( m_k + 2 kappa - S_k , 4 kappa - S_k )"
[lane-lp-product-saddle-v1.md:153]; active branch, verbatim: "g(N) < 2 for
all N >= 10, so the FIRST entry is the active minimum throughout:
c_H = (m_k + 2 kappa - S_k)/4" [lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:299-301].

------------------------------------------------------------------------
2. THE FATAL OBJECT REPAIR: THE PALM SET IS B_k, NOT M \ R_0
------------------------------------------------------------------------
The design displays, verbatim: "E_Palm[V_{outside-R_0}] =
E_Palm[V_{w_phi=0, E>S_k+c_H}] + E_Palm[V_{w_phi != 0}]"
[lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:3808-3809]. With
"R_0 := {w_theta = k, w_phi = 0, E_eps <= S_k + c_H}"
[lane-lp-product-saddle-v1.md:216-217], this is NOT an equality: the
complement M \ R_0 also contains the slice {w_theta != k, w_phi = 0,
E_eps <= S_k + c_H}, which the two displayed terms omit.

The omitted slice is non-empty and carries a level BELOW the base ball's.
WITNESS. Let x_0 in M = T^N_theta x T^N_phi be the doubly constant
configuration (all theta_i equal, all phi_i equal). Then every theta-bond
d_i = 0 and every phi-bond e_i = 0, so J_kappa(x_0) = kappa sum_i(1-cos 0)
= 0 and J_lambda(x_0) = 0; and by the coupled-pair member form, verbatim
"E_eps = J_kappa + J_lambda + eps W, W = sum_i (1 - cos(d_i - e_i)),
0 <= W <= 2N" [governance/c6-la2f-brief-gate-v11-surface-v1.md:36-37],
W(x_0) = sum_i (1 - cos 0) = 0. Hence E_eps(x_0) = 0 <= S_k + c_H, while
w_theta(x_0) = 0 != 1 = k and w_phi(x_0) = 0. So x_0 in M \ R_0.

By M5-COERCE, verbatim "E_eps(x) - (m_k + eps w_k) >= (c_perp/2)
dist(x, G_k)^2 on U" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:1395], E_eps >= m_k + eps w_k
everywhere on S. Comparing a fixed small box around x_0 with S in the
Z_beta-free Gibbs ratio therefore gives
   rho_beta(M \ R_0)/rho_beta(S) >= c(N,r) exp( +beta ( m_k + eps w_k
                                                  - sup_{box} E_eps ) ),
and since m_k + eps w_k = (1+eps) g(N) > 0 is bounded away from 0 while
sup_{box} E_eps -> 0 as the box shrinks, this ratio is exponentially
LARGE in beta. A claimed bound of the form <= exp(-beta(...)) at the Palm
object is therefore FALSE for B = M \ R_0. This is exactly the object slip
SR-PE1 warns of: OBJECT-PE1 carries "NO absorbing theta-label event"
[lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1936-1937], so its cycle is free to sit in the
winding-0 region for its duration, which is itself exponentially long
("E_{Palm}[C] is beta-DEPENDENT (when a deeper theta-well is reachable the
S-cycle entrance rate lambda_S is exponentially small, so E_{Palm}[C] =
1/lambda_S is exponentially large" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1902-1905]).

REPAIR (adopted, exponents unchanged). Apply (KAC-RATIO) with
   B := B_k := {w_theta = k} INTERSECT ( {E_eps >= S_k+c_H} UNION {w_phi != 0} ),
B' := S. The label restriction is not cosmetic: it is what makes the two
legs of Section 5 legitimate. Note B_k SUBSET {w_theta = k}, so B_k lies
OFF Delta_theta, w_theta being "well defined and locally constant off
`Delta`. The SECTORS `Sigma_k = {w = k}` are open"
[governance/la3-reader-packet-v1.md:55-56]. The set-theoretic decomposition
is a CONTAINMENT, not an equality:
   B_k SUBSET B_out UNION STRAT,
   B_out := { x in T^{2N} : E_eps(x) >= S_k + c_H }
            [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:520],
   STRAT := {w_theta = k} \ {w_phi = 0}   (R3-STRAT's set, Section 0).
This is what licenses Section 5's subadditive split.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
3. LEMMA R3-ASM.1 (LEM-LABEL) — THE CONSTANT-LABEL DOMINATION
        (PATHWISE; SUPERSEDES THE IMPORTED PE.4 ASSERTION)
------------------------------------------------------------------------
CLAIM. Fix i >= 1 and a path of X. Then
 (a) w_theta(X_s) = k for every s in [sigma_{i-1}, T_i) at which w_theta
     is defined, and the exceptional time set is contained in the path's
     time in Delta_theta;
 (b) { s in [sigma_{i-1}, T_i) : X_s not in R_0 } SUBSET
     { s in [sigma_{i-1}, T_i) : X_s in B_k } UNION
     { s in [sigma_{i-1}, T_i) : X_s in Delta_theta };
 (c) [sigma_{i-1}, T_i) SUBSET [sigma_{i-1}, D(sigma_{i-1})), hence the
     round's occupation of any Borel set is at most the delayed cycle's.

PROOF. (a) T_i := min( D(sigma_{i-1}), L_i ) <= L_i
[lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3048], so [sigma_{i-1}, T_i) SUBSET
[sigma_{i-1}, L_i). L_i := inf{ s > sigma_{i-1} : w_theta(X_s) != k }
[lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3044]; by the definition of an infimum, no
s in (sigma_{i-1}, L_i) has w_theta(X_s) != k. At the left endpoint,
X_{sigma_{i-1}} in S [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3037] and S SUBSET S^+
SUBSET U_ch [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3009], a subset of the winding-k
ground tube, verbatim: "[theta]  r_0' <= (1/2) dist(Z, Delta_theta) > 0
(SP_k's max bond is pi - a_k < pi, compactness): T_{r_0'} misses
Delta_theta - w_theta = k on the tube" [lane-lp-product-saddle-v1.md:176-178].
Two readings of L_i are possible and BOTH give (a). Reading (i): L_i is the
first exit from the open sector Sigma_k; then the path stays in Sigma_k on
[sigma_{i-1}, T_i) and never meets Delta_theta there, and the exceptional
set is empty. Reading (ii): L_i is "the first hit of a different open
theta-sector across Delta_theta"
[lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3001]; then the path stays in the closure of
Sigma_k, so w_theta = k wherever it is defined, and the exceptional times
are exactly the Delta_theta times.
(b) Let s in [sigma_{i-1}, T_i) with X_s not in R_0 and X_s not in
Delta_theta. By (a), w_theta(X_s) = k, so the first clause of R_0 holds
and the failure must be in the remaining two clauses: either
w_phi(X_s) != 0 (including w_phi undefined, i.e. X_s in Delta_phi, which
R3-STRAT's STRAT contains by construction) or E_eps(X_s) > S_k + c_H,
which implies E_eps(X_s) >= S_k + c_H. Hence X_s in B_k.
(c) T_i <= D(sigma_{i-1}) by [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3048], and
occupation of a Borel set over a shorter interval is no larger. QED.

REMARK (this replaces an import). The design instructs the assembly to
cite PE.4's "The domination 'absorption only truncates' IS valid (a
theta-crossing mid-excursion only removes outside-time)"
[lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:97-99]. Part (c) DERIVES that direction on the
actual terminus object, from the definition T_i = min(D, L_i) alone; the
design sentence is therefore recorded as concordant, not consumed as an
axiom. Part (a) is the strictly stronger statement the assembly actually
needs: it converts "outside R_0" into "in B_k", which the PE.4 sentence
does not do and which is exactly the FATAL gap of Section 2.

REMARK (the Delta_theta remainder costs nothing, two independent routes).
(1) PALM ROUTE. Delta_theta is a finite union of smooth codimension-1
tori, hence Lebesgue-null; rho_beta is absolutely continuous with
"strictly positive smooth density" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1856-1858],
so rho_beta(Delta_theta) = 0 and (KAC-OCC) gives directly
E_{Palm}^{pl}[V_{Delta_theta}] = rho_beta(Delta_theta) . E_{Palm}^{pl}[C]
= 0, using only 0 < E_{Palm}^{pl}[C] < infinity, i.e. (INT). No new import.
(2) ROUND ROUTE. For x in S, t > 0, by the strong Markov property at
sigma_{i-1} (§3 above) and Tonelli, E( int_{sigma_{i-1}}^{(sigma_{i-1}+t)
AND T_i} 1_{Delta_theta}(X_s) ds | F_{sigma_{i-1}} ) <=
int_0^t P_{X_{sigma_{i-1}}}( X_u in Delta_theta ) du = 0, because the
transition density exists and is positive — hypothesis row SR-PE1.1(a),
matched verbatim: "L is uniformly elliptic with smooth coefficients, so by
the parabolic Hormander / Aronson two-sided heat-kernel bounds the
transition density p_t(x,y) is strictly positive for every t>0 and all
x,y in M" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1828-1831]. Monotone convergence in t
gives 0. The conditioning sigma-field is F_{sigma_{i-1}}, the stopped
sigma-field of [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3035]. This also DISCHARGES, at
Palm level and at round level, the carry R3-STRAT typed as
GAP-R3STRAT-DELTATHETA, and by the null-mass route it asked for, not a
level route.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
4. THE PALM ASSEMBLY — (KAC-RATIO) AT B = B_k, B' = S
------------------------------------------------------------------------
SR-PE1 round 2 delivers, on OBJECT-PE1 and at exactly this strength,
verbatim:
  "(KAC-OCC)   E_{Palm}[ V_B ] = rho_beta(B) . E_{Palm}[C]  for every Borel B,
   (KAC-RATIO) E_{Palm}[ V_B ] / E_{Palm}[ V_{B'} ] = rho_beta(B)/rho_beta(B')
                 for Borel B, B' with rho_beta(B') > 0,
   (INT)       0 < E_{Palm}[C] < infinity, and (PALM-INV) E_{Palm}[C] = 1/lambda_S."
  [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1916-1919]
with hypothesis rows SR-PE1.1 (positive Harris recurrence on compact
elliptic M), SR-PE1.2 (rho_beta = Gibbs, detailed balance) and SR-PE1.3
((INT)) all MATCHED there [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1822-1910]. NAMED
CLASSICAL IMPORT, not reproduced here: Asmussen Ch. VI (RR/KAC-OCC);
Baccelli-Bremaud Ch. 1 and Thorisson Ch. 8-10 (PALM-INV); Kac 1947 with
Meyn-Tweedie Ch. 10, 17; Nummelin Ch. 4
[lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1799-1818]. I do not restate or strengthen
them; I only instantiate B, B'.

ADMISSIBILITY. rho_beta(S) > 0: S is a nonempty open ball and rho_beta has
a strictly positive density [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1856-1858]. Hence
(KAC-RATIO) applies at B' = S, and (KAC-OCC) at B = S with (INT) gives
E_{Palm}^{pl}[V_S] = rho_beta(S) E_{Palm}^{pl}[C] in (0, infinity), so the
ratio is not 0/0 and the equality can be multiplied out:

 (ASM-0)  E_{Palm}^{pl}[ V_{B_k} ] = ( rho_beta(B_k)/rho_beta(S) )
                                     . E_{Palm}^{pl}[ V_S ].

This is the design's collapse: "The unknown cycle length E_Palm[C]
CANCELS" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:3779]. No quasi-stationary device, no
basin, no reachability, no entry-probability x dwell decomposition enters.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
5. THE GIBBS RATIO — TWO LEGS OVER A COMMON DENOMINATOR
------------------------------------------------------------------------
By Section 2's containment and subadditivity of rho_beta, and since Z_beta
cancels in every ratio,
   rho_beta(B_k)/rho_beta(S) <= [int_{B_out} e^{-beta E_eps}]/[int_S e^{-beta E_eps}]
                              + [int_{STRAT} e^{-beta E_eps}]/[int_S e^{-beta E_eps}].

DENOMINATOR (both legs, the SAME one). Consume R3-STRAT's (DEN-S3) as a
NAMED INTERFACE at its stated strength:
   int_S e^{-beta E_eps} >= (delta/2)^{2N} exp(-beta( m_k + eps w_k
                                              + L_eps N delta^2/16 )),  (DEN-S3)
valid for delta/4 <= r0 with the max-norm box of half-side delta/4
embedded; it consumes only PE.2(a)'s (UP-QUAD) plus the corpus max-norm
convention and dist_euc <= sqrt(2N) dist_max. R3-STRAT flags, and I HONOR,
the discipline that PE.2(a)'s (DEN) — "Z_beta >= c(N) beta^{-(N-1)}
e^{-beta(m_k + eps w_k)}" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:637] — must NOT be
substituted here in EITHER leg: it lower-bounds the FULL tube integral,
which DOMINATES int_S, so using it would produce int/(something larger)
and an INVALID upper bound on the ratio. Section 5 of PE.2(a), "the
beta-free tube volume v(N, delta)" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:709-712],
has the identical defect and is likewise not used.

DOORWAY LEG. {w_theta = k, E_eps >= S_k + c_H} SUBSET B_out, so PE.2(a)'s
numerator applies verbatim: "integral_{B_out} e^{-beta E_eps} dx <=
Leb(B_out) e^{-beta(S_k + c_H)} <= V_M e^{-beta(S_k + c_H)}, (NUM)"
[lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:556-557]. Dividing (NUM) by (DEN-S3):
   rho_beta(B_out)/rho_beta(S)
     <= V_M (2/delta)^{2N} exp( -beta ( S_k + c_H - m_k - err ) ),   (LEG-D)
   err := eps w_k + L_eps N delta^2/16.
Only (NUM) and (UP-QUAD) are taken from PE.2(a); its assembled (PE2a) and
its (ERR) are NOT consumed, and consequently the (N-1)(ln beta)/beta
summand of PE.2(a)'s (ERR) does NOT appear here — (DEN-S3) is beta-free.

STRATUM LEG. Consume R3-STRAT's (FLOOR) as a NAMED INTERFACE at its stated
strength: on STRAT = {w_theta = k} \ {w_phi = 0}, E_eps >= m_k + m_1(lambda),
proved there unconditionally on the flagship range from (SHARP)
E_eps >= J_kappa + J_lambda pointwise with W* >= 0 (so NO "-2 eps N"
slack), the sector minimum "[STD]   sector minimum: J >= m_k on the
winding-k sector (via the ridge: min over [2 pi k/N, pi] of phi_k = m_k)"
[governance/gate-v17-la2f-brief-lt-v1.md:54-55], the |j| >= 2 legs, and the
Delta_phi face at 2 lambda > m_1(lambda) (since g(N) < 2 on N >= 10). The
J_kappa >= m_k half of that floor is available ONLY because B_k carries the
label restriction w_theta = k — this is precisely the leg that the design's
unrestricted M \ R_0 would have destroyed. Then Leb(STRAT) <= V_M gives
   rho_beta(STRAT)/rho_beta(S)
     <= V_M (2/delta)^{2N} exp( -beta ( m_1(lambda) - err ) ).      (LEG-S)
The m_k of the floor cancels against the m_k of (DEN-S3): the ratio is
measured from the base ball's own level, which is why the surviving
exponent is m_1(lambda) and not m_k + m_1(lambda). This reproduces
independently the exponent ADJ-2 obtains by its own route, verbatim:
"= c(delta) exp( -beta( m_1(lambda) + o(1) ) ).        (PR)"
[lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:720] — recorded as concordance; (PR) is a LOWER
bound and is NOT consumed upward anywhere.

SUM. (LEG-D) + (LEG-S) <= 2 V_M (2/delta)^{2N}
      exp( -beta ( min( S_k + c_H - m_k , m_1(lambda) ) - err ) ).  (RATIO)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
6. THE SOJOURN FACTOR
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Consume R3-SOJ as a NAMED INTERFACE at its stated strength, in its
OBJECT-FREE form:
   sup_{x in S} E_x[ theta^+(0) ] <= (1/8) N beta delta^2 .          (R3-SOJ.a)
Because the Palm entrance law rho_S^Palm is carried on S
[lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1937-1938], and by the strong Markov property
at the stopping time T_0 with respect to the stopped sigma-field F_{T_0}
(the filtration of [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3035]), together with R3-SOJ's
containment V_S^{pl} <= theta^+(T_0) - T_0 (its Section 2b: the plain cycle
ends at the first S-entrance after the first S-exit tau_S, and tau_S <=
theta^+(T_0) since S SUBSET S^+, [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3009]),
   E_{Palm}^{pl}[ V_S ] <= E_{Palm}^{pl}[ theta^+(T_0) - T_0 ]
                        <= sup_{x in S} E_x[theta^+(0)]
                        <= (1/8) N beta delta^2 .                     (SOJ)
No entrance law is used in the last two steps: a supremum over start points
is entrance-law-free. This is why R3-SOJ's object-free form is the right
interface, and it is also why the SAME bound is available on O4 and O5 when
R3-PE3p needs it (R3-SOJ Sections 2a, 2c). It is POLYNOMIAL in beta of
degree 1, hence err-class under the mandated order of limits.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
7. THE ASSEMBLED ROW
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Insert (RATIO) and (SOJ) into (ASM-0):

 (ASM-PALM)  E_{Palm}^{pl}[ V_{B_k} ]
   <= 2 V_M (2/delta)^{2N} . (1/8) N beta delta^2
      . exp( -beta ( min( S_k + c_H - m_k , m_1(lambda) ) - err ) )
   =  T(N,delta) . beta . exp( -beta ( min( S_k+c_H-m_k , m_1(lambda) ) - err ) ),
   T(N,delta) := (1/4) N delta^2 V_M (2/delta)^{2N}   (beta-free, explicit),
   err        := eps w_k + L_eps N delta^2/16          (beta-free).

Every constant is beta-free and explicit; the only beta-dependence outside
the exponential is the single factor beta from (SOJ), i.e. poly(beta) of
degree 1. Both err summands are non-negative; neither contains a
(ln beta)/beta term, because (DEN-S3) carries no Laplace prefactor.

------------------------------------------------------------------------
8. THE MARGIN ARITHMETIC — BOTH REGIMES, DISPLAYED
------------------------------------------------------------------------
Write, at kappa = 1, k = 1, active c_H branch:
   Delta_door := S_k + c_H - m_k = ( 3(S_k - m_k) + 2 kappa )/4
        [the closed form of lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:694], LAMBDA-FREE;
   Delta_strat := m_1(lambda) = lambda g(N), STRICTLY INCREASING in lambda.
So min(Delta_door, Delta_strat) = Delta_strat iff lambda <= lambda*(N) :=
Delta_door/g(N), and = Delta_door iff lambda > lambda*(N). BOTH REGIMES ARE
REALIZED INSIDE THE FLAGSHIP RANGE (kappa = 1, lambda > kappa, N >= 10),
and this is the point at which ADJ-2's recorded numbers cease to be this
row's numbers.

REGIME A (lambda <= lambda*(N); the STRATUM term is the min). Margin over
the row's target c_H/2 is exactly ADJ-2's identity, verbatim:
   "m_1 - c_H/2 = lambda g(N) - (1/8)( g(N) + 2 - S_k ) = g(N)( lambda -
   1/8 ) + ( S_k - 2 )/8" [lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:730],

------------------------------------------------------------------------
Since sup_{beta >= 0} beta e^{-beta mu} = 1/(e mu),
   T(N,delta) beta e^{-beta( c_H/2 + 2 mu )}
     = T(N,delta) ( beta e^{-beta mu} ) e^{-beta( c_H/2 + mu )}
     <= [ T(N,delta)/(e mu) ] e^{-beta c_H/2}   for every beta >= 0.
Hence, on OBJECT-PE1 and for every beta >= beta_0(delta,eps),
   E_{Palm}^{pl}[ V_{B_k} ] <= T_row(N,delta,eps,lambda) exp( -beta c_H/2 ),
   T_row := T(N,delta)/(e mu),  beta-FREE and explicit,

err(delta))), T_row beta-free" [lane-lp-product-saddle-v1.md:222-224] with
err(delta) taken to be 0 in the exponent — the margin is cleared outright,
not spent.

Setting, verbatim: "dX_t = -grad E_eps(X_t) dt + sqrt(2/beta) dW_t on
M = T^{2N}, flagship k=1, N>=10, M2-PIN (lambda>kappa), eps in [0, eps_2)
fixed" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3001]. Base ball and collar, verbatim:
"S := B_{delta/4}(g*)" [:3008]; "S^+ := B_{delta/2}(g*) (= B_h(g*) - the
exit collar), S subset S^+ subset U_ch" [:3009], h = delta/2.

Filtration, verbatim: "Let (F_t)_{t>=0} be the augmented natural
filtration of the diffusion X, F_t := sigma(X_{s} : s <= t) completed and
made right-continuous. ... theta^+(.), D(.), the sigma_i, and the crossing
time (§4) are all hitting times of Borel sets by the continuous process X,
hence (F_t)-stopping times; F_{sigma_{i-1}} is the corresponding stopped
sigma-field. Because the SDE is autonomous, the strong Markov property
holds at each sigma_{i-1}." [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3035].

Stopping objects. theta^+(t) := inf{s >= t : X_s not in S^+}; D(t) :=
inf{s >= theta^+(t) : X_s in S} [:3015-3016]. Round terminus
T_i := min(D(sigma_{i-1}), L_i) [:3048] with
L_i := inf{s > sigma_{i-1} : w_theta(X_s) != k} [:3044]. Round-start law,
verbatim: "There is no fixed regeneration law nu here: X_{sigma_{i-1}} is
an arbitrary (F_{sigma_{i-1}}-measurable) point of S" [:3037].

THE ROUND FUNCTIONAL. For y in M write, on the path started at y with
D(0), L, T := min(D(0), L) read from the shifted origin,

   u(y) := E_y[ integral_0^{T} 1_{M \ R_0}(X_s) ds ]   in [0, infinity].

This is the R5a DELAYED round object, not the plain S-return cycle
(OBJECT-PE1, lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1936-1941) and not the delayed
Palm cycle. Every displayed statement below names which of the three it
rides.

========================================================================
3. (PE3p.1) THE REDUCTION: THE CONDITIONAL ROW IS EXACTLY A SUPREMUM
========================================================================
LEMMA PE3p.1. For every i >= 1, on the R5a round object,

   E( integral_{sigma_{i-1}}^{T_i} 1_{M \ R_0}(X_s) ds | F_{sigma_{i-1}} )
        = u( X_{sigma_{i-1}} )        a.s.

Consequently ROW PROD-EXCURSION-COND holds at strength
T_row exp(-beta(c_H/2 - err)) for EVERY admissible round-start field and
EVERY F_{sigma_{i-1}}-measurable start in S IF AND ONLY IF

   sup_{x in S} u(x) <= T_row(eps,delta) exp( -beta( c_H/2 - err(delta) ) ).
                                                                   (COND*)

PROOF. The occupation functional integral_0^{T} 1_{M\R_0}(X_s) ds is a
non-negative Borel functional of the POST-sigma_{i-1} path alone (T is
defined from the shifted origin), so its P_y-expectation u(y) is a Borel
function of the start point alone - the same status R5a records for Phi
and Psi at [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3064]. The identity is then the
verbatim §5 template applied to this functional: "By the strong Markov
property at sigma_{i-1} (§3), the regular conditional law of the
post-sigma_{i-1} path given F_{sigma_{i-1}} is P_{X_{sigma_{i-1}}},
evaluated at the F_{sigma_{i-1}}-measurable random variable
X_{sigma_{i-1}}" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3064], followed by
"P( round i crosses | F_{sigma_{i-1}} ) = Phi( X_{sigma_{i-1}} ) a.s."
[:3066] read for u instead of Phi. Non-negativity gives the conditional
expectation without integrability hypotheses (it may a priori be
+infinity). Since X_{sigma_{i-1}} ranges over S and is otherwise
arbitrary [:3037], the a.s.-uniform conditional bound is equivalent to
the pointwise supremum bound (COND*). QED.

NO INDEPENDENCE IS CLAIMED. The conditioning field is the pre-sigma_{i-1}
path field; the functional is post-sigma_{i-1}; the only fact used is the
strong-Markov equality of conditional laws, exactly as R5a states at
:3069.

CONSEQUENCE FOR THE TYPED DELTAS. Lemma PE3p.1 discharges, outright, the
CONDITIONING half of DELTA-PE1-ENTRANCE: the passage "from the averaged
cycle identity to an a.s. bound conditional on F_{sigma_{i-1}}"
[lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:90-92] is not an analytic burden at all once
the functional is recognised as start-point-measurable; the ENTIRE
analytic burden of that delta is the UNIFORMITY over x in S, i.e. the
supremum in (COND*). This is a real sharpening of the typed delta: it
localises the burden to one scalar quantity on one object.

========================================================================
4. (PE3p.2) THE ROUND FUNCTIONAL ON M AND THE DELAYED-RETURN DOMINATION
========================================================================
LEMMA PE3p.2. Let x in M and t >= 0. Then, a.s.,
 (i)  D(t) >= D(0) whenever t <= D(0);
 (ii) on {T > t}, E( integral_t^{T} 1_{M\R_0}(X_s) ds | F_t ) <= u(X_t);
 (iii) for every x in S, u(x) = E_x[ W(X_{theta^+(0)}) ] where
       W(z) := E_z[ integral_0^{H_S wedge L} 1_{M\R_0}(X_s) ds ] and
       H_S := inf{s >= 0 : X_s in S}. In particular the pre-collar-exit
       stretch contributes NOTHING.

PROOF. (i) Three cases, all read off the definitions [:3015-3016]. If
theta^+(0) > t then X_t in S^+ and theta^+(t) = theta^+(0), so
D(t) = D(0). If theta^+(0) <= t and X_t not in S^+, then theta^+(t) = t
and D(t) = inf{s >= t : X_s in S} = D(0) (no S-entrance occurred in
[theta^+(0), t] since t < D(0)). If theta^+(0) <= t and X_t in S^+ \ S,
then theta^+(t) >= t is the NEXT collar exit and D(t) is the first
S-entrance after it, hence D(t) >= D(0). In all cases D(t) >= D(0).
(ii) On {T > t} the label has not changed, so L read from t equals L. By
(i) the terminus read from t, min(D(t), L), is >= min(D(0), L) = T. The
Markov property at the deterministic time t (autonomy, :3035) gives
E( integral_t^{min(D(t),L)} 1_{M\R_0} | F_t ) = u(X_t), and the integrand
is non-negative, so the integral to T is dominated by the integral to
min(D(t),L). Hence the stated inequality.
(iii) A path started in S lies in S^+, and "A path with X_t in S lies
inside the collar S^+, so theta^+(t) requires the radial coordinate
dist(.,g*) to reach delta/2 before D(t) can fire ... D(t) > t strictly.
There are NO trivial zero-time returns" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3018].
On [0, theta^+(0)] the path lies in S^+ subset U_ch, which misses both
Delta faces by the ledger, verbatim "[phi] ... T_{r_0'} misses Delta_phi
by level (E_0 there >= m_k + 2 lambda > m_k + 2 kappa >= S_k + 4 c_H >=
sup_{T_{r_0'}} E_0)" and "[theta] ... T_{r_0'} misses Delta_theta -
w_theta = k on the tube" [lane-lp-product-saddle-v1.md:173-179], and
carries E_eps <= m_k + eps w_k + (L_eps/2) dist(.,G_k)^2 by (UP-QUAD)
[lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:601], hence lies in R_0 for delta small (§6.1).
So the [0, theta^+(0)] stretch contributes 0 to the outside occupation.
Also L > theta^+(0) always, verbatim "the theta-label is constantly k on
[t, theta^+(t)]: any theta-label change is strictly later than
theta^+(t)" [:3018]. After theta^+(0) the terminus min(D(0),L) is exactly
H_S wedge L read from theta^+(0). Strong Markov at theta^+(0) gives (iii).
QED.

Lemma PE3p.2(iii) also DERIVES, on this object, the direction PE.4
asserts ("absorption only truncates", design:97-99): the label change
terminates the accounting, it never adds outside time. I do not consume
PE.4; I record it as a design assertion (C5).

DELTA-PE1-DELAYED, DISPOSED OF ON MY LEGS. Every object in Lemmas
PE3p.1-PE3p.2 is the DELAYED terminus min(D(0), L). No plain S-return
cycle appears on any leg I prove. The plain-vs-delayed delta therefore
does NOT arise in §§3-6; it survives only where R3-ASM's Palm input is
consumed (§7), and is inherited there verbatim, not re-opened.

========================================================================
5. (PE3p.3)+(PE3p.4) THE DOORWAY FUNNEL AND THE FIRST-WINDOW CHARGE
========================================================================
5.1 WHY A CHARGE IS UNAVOIDABLE, AND WHY THE NAIVE ONE IS FATAL. The
occupation integrand is bounded by 1 per unit time, so any decomposition
of the round at a horizon t_0 pays, on the first window, at most t_0. But
T_row must be beta-free while the target carries exp(-beta(c_H/2 - err));
an ADDITIVE beta-free t_0 destroys the row for every t_0 > 0, including
t_0 = O(delta^2). So the [0,t_0] outside occupation must itself be shown
exponentially small. The only large-deviation tools in the corpus are the
FW LOWER halves SR-T2 [lane-c-exit-time-lower-bound-v1.md:51-96] and SR-T3
[lane-c-sector-persistence-readout-theorem-v1.md:30-51], which cannot
bound an escape probability from ABOVE, and every other allowed source is
a FLOOR (L1/L1'/L2 densities and hops, M5-MAIN, M3-GS) or a determinism
(M2P.5) or an identity (SR-PE1) or a static ratio (PE.2(a), R3-STRAT). I
therefore assert NO large-deviation upper bound. Instead:

5.2 LEMMA PE3p.3 (DOORWAY FUNNEL). Let x in S with E_eps(x) < S_k + c_H,
and let T = min(D(0), L). Put

   tau_lev := inf{ s >= 0 : E_eps(X_s) >= S_k + c_H }.

Then for every s in [0, T) with X_s not in R_0 one has tau_lev <= s. Hence

   { integral_0^{T wedge t_0} 1_{M\R_0}(X_s) ds > 0 } subset { tau_lev <= t_0 }.

PROOF. Fix s < T with X_s not in R_0. Since s < T <= L and L is the first
time the theta-label differs from k [:3044], w_theta(X_s) = k; in
particular X_s is not on Delta_theta, and the winding-k sector is open
[la3-reader-packet-v1.md:55-56]. Three exhaustive cases.
 (a) E_eps(X_s) > S_k + c_H. Then tau_lev <= s directly.
 (b) w_phi(X_s) = j != 0. The start x in S has w_phi = 0 ([phi] ledger,
     lane-lp:173-175). The winding is "well defined and locally constant
     off Delta" [la3:55], so by continuity of the path there is
     s' in (0, s] with X_{s'} in Delta_phi. Case (c) applies at s'.
 (c) X_s (resp. X_{s'}) lies on Delta_phi. There "LEMMA B.1 (barrier).
     `J_mu >= 2 mu` on `Delta`" [la3-reader-packet-v1.md:355-356] gives
     J_lambda >= 2 lambda. Since the theta-label is still k, the sector
     minimum "[STD] sector minimum: J >= m_k on the winding-k sector (via
     the ridge: min over [2 pi k/N, pi] of phi_k = m_k)"
     [gate-v17-la2f-brief-lt-v1.md:54-55] gives J_kappa >= m_k. The
     coupling enters with the correct sign: "`E_0 := J_kappa + J_lambda`
     (the eps-free envelope); `E_eps = E_0 + eps W*`, `W* >= 0`"
     [lane-lp-product-saddle-v1.md:85-86]. Hence
        E_eps >= m_k + 2 lambda >= m_k + 2 kappa = S_k + 4 c_H > S_k + c_H,
     using M2-PIN lambda > kappa and the ACTIVE ledger branch
     c_H = (m_k + 2 kappa - S_k)/4 [lane-lp:152-155; active on all
     N >= 10 since g(N) < 2, design:293-303]. So tau_lev <= s' <= s.
QED.

READING. On R5a's terminus the ONLY way to accrue outside-R_0 time is to
climb the LEVEL to the doorway S_k + c_H. The theta-label exit is not an
exit that accrues time - IT IS THE TERMINUS (I4, :3048), exactly as the
ROW itself says: "a Delta_theta hit IS the renewal's target event"
[lane-lp-product-saddle-v1.md:219]. The Delta_phi exit is level-blocked
by the c_H ledger, again as the ROW says: "Delta_phi is level-blocked
inside R_0 by the c_H ledger" [lane-lp:218-219].

5.3 LEMMA PE3p.4 (THE FIRST-WINDOW CHARGE). Put
   M_2^eps := sup_M |Delta E_eps|  (finite; the corpus's named constant
   class "M_2 := sup_M |Delta E| (< infinity)"
   [lane-sh2local-proofs-v1.md:244]),
and note the EXPLICIT beta-free bound, computed from the corpus member
form "E_eps = J_kappa(theta) + J_lambda(phi) + eps W(theta, phi) with
W = sum_i (1 - cos(d_i - e_i))"
[c7-la2f-brief-parity-artifact-v1.md:37-38]:
   Delta J_kappa = 2 kappa sum_i cos d_i,  Delta J_lambda = 2 lambda sum_i cos e_i,
   Delta W = 4 sum_i cos(d_i - e_i),
   hence  M_2^eps <= 2N(kappa + lambda) + 4 eps N   (beta-free).
Then for every t_0 > 0 and every x in S,

   E_x[ integral_0^{T wedge t_0} 1_{M\R_0}(X_s) ds ]
        <= t_0 P_x( tau_lev <= t_0 )
        <= t_0 exp( M_2^eps t_0 ) exp( -beta ( S_k + c_H - E_eps(x) ) ).   (FW)

PROOF. The first inequality is Lemma PE3p.3 plus the bound 1 on the
integrand. For the second, set f := exp(beta E_eps) in C^infinity(M),
bounded on the compact M, and compute the generator
L = (1/beta) Delta - grad E_eps . grad on f:
   grad f = beta f grad E_eps,
   Delta f = div(beta f grad E_eps) = f( beta^2 |grad E_eps|^2 + beta Delta E_eps ),
   L f = f( beta |grad E_eps|^2 + Delta E_eps ) - beta f |grad E_eps|^2
       = f . Delta E_eps  <=  M_2^eps f.
The |grad E_eps|^2 terms CANCEL EXACTLY (f is the reciprocal Gibbs
density up to Z_beta), so the constant M_2^eps is BETA-FREE. Put
Y_t := exp(-M_2^eps t) f(X_t). By SR-ITO (I22),
   dY_t = e^{-M_2^eps t}[ (L f - M_2^eps f)(X_t) dt
                          + sqrt(2/beta) grad f(X_t) . dW_t ],
the drift is <= 0 and grad f is bounded on M, so the stochastic integral
is a true martingale on [0,t_0] and Y is a supermartingale there. By
SR-OST at the bounded stopping time tau_lev wedge t_0,
   E_x[ Y_{tau_lev wedge t_0} ] <= Y_0 = f(x).
Y >= 0, and on {tau_lev <= t_0} path continuity of E_eps o X gives
E_eps(X_{tau_lev}) = S_k + c_H, whence
Y_{tau_lev} >= e^{-M_2^eps t_0} e^{beta(S_k + c_H)}. Therefore
   e^{-M_2^eps t_0} e^{beta(S_k+c_H)} P_x(tau_lev <= t_0) <= e^{beta E_eps(x)},
which is (FW). QED.

Finally, for x in S, (UP-QUAD) "E_eps(x) <= m_k + eps w_k + (L_eps/2)
dist(x, G_k)^2 on U" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:601] with the corpus
max-norm convention [lane-lp:93-101] and the one-way conversion
dist_euc <= sqrt(2N) dist_max gives dist(x,G_k)_euc <= sqrt(2N) delta/4
and hence

   sup_{x in S} E_eps(x) <= m_k + eps w_k + L_eps N delta^2/16,   (E-TOP)

so that

   sup_{x in S} E_x[ integral_0^{T wedge t_0} 1_{M\R_0} ]
     <= t_0 e^{M_2^eps t_0}
        exp( -beta ( S_k + c_H - m_k - eps w_k - L_eps N delta^2/16 ) ).  (FW-S)

The prefactor t_0 e^{M_2^eps t_0} is BETA-FREE - the only thing the row
requires of T_row [lane-lp:223-224] - and the exponent is verified
against c_H/2 in §6.

5.4 THE RIDGE LAW: ENTERED IN THE DAG, AND WHY IT IS NOT LOAD-BEARING
HERE (a correction to the spec-lens, recorded with its arithmetic). The
spec-lens prices a theta-label exit by the ridge law
"`J >= phi_k(M_abs)` pointwise" [lane-ls-label-sharpness-v1.md:278] and
warns that without it the theta-exit forces only J_kappa >= 2 kappa,
exponent (2 - 1.9098)/2 = 0.045 < c_H/2, so "the bound FAILS". On R5a's
terminus that charge does not arise at all: Lemma PE3p.3 shows the
theta-label exit IS the terminus, so it accrues no outside time. The
ridge law is nevertheless ENTERED IN THE DAG (I15) and its arithmetic is
recorded as a robustness leg, with ONE CORRECTION: a Delta_theta hit
forces the max absolute bond to pi, not to pi - a_k, so the level it
forces is phi_k(pi), NOT S_k. From
phi_k(m) = kappa[(1 - cos m) + (N-1)(1 - cos((2 pi k - m)/(N-1)))]
[lane-ls-label-sharpness-v1.md:205] at k = 1, m = pi:
   phi_1(pi) = 2 + (N-1)(1 - cos(pi/(N-1)))   <   S_k = 2 + (N-2)(1 - cos(pi/(N-2))),
the inequality because (1 - cos s)/s is strictly increasing on (0,2]
[lane-lt-label-tower-v1.md:114-115] and pi/(N-1) < pi/(N-2). The residual
mean at m = pi is r = pi/(N-1) <= pi/9 = 0.349, inside the ridge law's
explicit range condition r in [0, 3/4] [lane-ls:280-286], so the law
applies. At N = 10, kappa = 1: phi_1(pi) = 2.54277 against
S_k = 2.60896; the honest theta-exit margin is
phi_1(pi) - m_k - c_H = 2.54277 - 1.90983 - 0.32522 = 0.30772 > 0
(the lens's figure, which uses S_k, would read 0.37391). The margin is
INCREASING in N (0.30772, 0.44236, 0.55832, 1.00940, 1.60209, 1.98150 at
N = 10, 11, 12, 18, 46, 1000). So even in the pessimistic accounting in
which the theta-exit were charged, the row would survive - with the
corrected level and a smaller slack than the lens states. Neither reading
changes the delivered bound, which is governed by the doorway alone.

========================================================================
6. (PE3p.5) THE RENEWAL ALGEBRA, THE DOEBLIN AMPLIFICATION, AND THE
   BUDGET
========================================================================
6.1 S IS INTERIOR TO R_0. By (E-TOP), sup_S E_eps <= m_k + eps w_k +
L_eps N delta^2/16, and at the flagship N = 10 the doorway sits at
S_k + c_H = 2.93418 while m_k + eps w_k = 1.90983 + 0.05 x 1.90983 =
2.00532; the ledger tube also gives w_theta = k, w_phi = 0 on S
[lane-lp:173-179]. So S subset interior(R_0) for delta below the explicit
threshold L_eps N delta^2/16 < S_k + c_H - m_k - eps w_k (= 0.92886 at
the flagship), which is compatible with the mandated order of limits
(beta first at fixed delta, then delta -> 0)
[lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3121-3127].

6.2 A PRIORI FINITENESS. Define u^{(n)}(y) := E_y[ integral_0^{T wedge n}
1_{M\R_0} ] <= n. All inequalities below are proved for u^{(n)} with
constants independent of n and passed to the limit by monotone
convergence, u^{(n)} increases to u. This discharges the finiteness
caveat the spec-lens requires ("truncate at u ^ n and pass to the limit").

6.3 THE RENEWAL INEQUALITY. By Lemma PE3p.2(ii) and Lemma PE3p.3, for
every x in S and every t_0 > 0,

   u^{(n)}(x) <= A(x) + E_x[ 1_{T > t_0} u^{(n)}(X_{t_0}) ],
   A(x) := E_x[ integral_0^{T wedge t_0} 1_{M\R_0} ]
         <= t_0 e^{M_2^eps t_0} e^{-beta(S_k + c_H - E_eps(x))}.       (REN)

6.4 THE DOEBLIN INPUT AND ITS COST, EXACTLY. The corpus's own uniform
minorization onto the base ball is M3-GS, verbatim
"P_x( X_{n+1} in A ) >= p_chain . m_1 Leb(A) for all Borel A subset B_0"
[lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:739-741], with B_0 := B_{delta/4}(g*) = S
[:688], uniform over x in U_{1/2} = U_ch, where
p_chain = c_0^n exp(-2 beta C_1^eps n h^2) [:714-716] and
m_1 = c_0' beta^N exp(-beta C_2^eps . O(delta^2)) [:733-734], at the
beta-free integer time n + 1, n = ceil(4 pi sqrt(2N)/delta) [:697]. Thus

   P_y( X_{t_0} in . ) >= c nu(.)   for all y in U_ch,  t_0 := n + 1,
   c := p_chain . m_1 . Leb(S),  nu := Leb|_S / Leb(S),
   -beta^{-1} log c = Gamma_orb(h) + C_2^eps O(delta^2) - (N log beta)/beta
                      - beta^{-1} log(c_0^n c_0' Leb(S)),
   Gamma_orb(h) = 2 C_1 n h^2 <= 6 C_1 D_G h = O(h)
                  [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:1691].

DIRECTION CHECK (the spec-lens's second correction, adopted). A density
FLOOR transfers LOWER bounds pointwise; the COND row needs an UPPER
bound, so this is NOT a one-line domination. In the renewal form the
minorization enters as an AMPLIFICATION: the charge is divided by c, not
added to it. The amplification factor is
   1/c = exp( +beta ( Gamma_orb(h) + C_2^eps O(delta^2) ) ) beta^{-N}
         (c_0^n c_0' Leb(S))^{-1},
i.e. a beta-free-prefactor times exp(+beta O(h)) - note O(h) = O(delta),
NOT merely O(delta^2), because the ORBIT CHAIN, not L1' alone, is what
makes the minorization uniform over U_ch. This is exactly the err-class
that R5a's own D_bar already carries ("Gamma(h) := Gamma_orb + Gamma_dens
= O(h)", lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3078 - quoted here only to name the
class, not consumed as an input; the constant is re-derived above from
I7/I8), and it vanishes under the mandated order of limits.

6.5 THE AMPLIFICATION LEMMA (algebra, proved). Suppose, for some t_0 and
some probability nu on S:
  (H1) P_y(X_{t_0} in .) >= c nu(.) for all y in a set K with S subset K;
  (H2) for every x in S, X_{t_0} in K a.s. on {T > t_0};
  (H3) K = S (equivalently: the residual state is confined to S).
Then, writing A_sup := sup_S A and U_nu := integral_S u dnu,
   sup_S u <= A_sup / c + U_nu.
PROOF. Write P_x(X_{t_0} in .) = c nu(.) + (1-c) Q(x, .) with Q a
probability kernel; (H2)+(H3) put the whole of Q(x,.) on S. From (REN),
u^{(n)}(x) <= A_sup + c U_nu^{(n)} + (1-c) sup_S u^{(n)}; take the
supremum over x in S, use sup_S u^{(n)} <= n < infinity to rearrange,
and let n -> infinity. QED.

6.6 THE BUDGET, WITH THE ADJ-2 MARGIN DISPLAYED. Combining (FW-S) with
6.4-6.5, the required inequality is
   ( S_k + c_H - m_k ) - eps w_k - L_eps N delta^2/16
        - [ Gamma_orb(h) + C_2^eps O(delta^2) ]   >   c_H/2,          (B1)
for the doorway leg, and (from R3-ASM, I21, whose exponent is
min(S_k + c_H - m_k, m_1(lambda)))
   m_1(lambda) - eps w_k - err   >   c_H/2                            (B2)
for the stratum leg. Both are verified in closed form.

(B1) CLOSED FORM. With the active branch c_H = (m_k + 2 kappa - S_k)/4,
   S_k + c_H - m_k - c_H/2  =  (7/8)( S_k - m_k ) + kappa/4,
which is STRICTLY POSITIVE FOR EVERY N and every lambda, since PROD-SHELL
gives S_k > m_k [lane-lt-label-tower-v1.md:106-109,116-118], and is
INCREASING in N because S_k - m_k increases ("S_1 - m_1 INCREASES toward
2 kappa (0.70 kappa at N = 10; 0.882 at N = 12; 1.295 at N = 20)"
[lane-lt:116-118]). It is lambda-FREE: the doorway is a theta-side level.
Numerically (kappa = 1): 0.86174 at N = 10; 0.94699 at N = 11; 1.02152 at
N = 12; 1.31916 at N = 18; 1.72320 at N = 46; 1.98705 at N = 1000. The
worst cell on the whole flagship range is N = 10, and even there the
doorway exponent S_k + c_H - m_k = 1.02435 exceeds the target
c_H/2 = 0.16261 by 0.86174 - matching PE.4's own margin note "the
per-block exponent S_k + c_H - m_k ~ 1.02 at the flagship dwarfs the
c_H/2 = 0.163 target" [lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:108-109] (recorded as
CONTEXT C5, re-derived here, not consumed).

EPS CONDITION, N-FREE AND EXPLICIT. (B1) needs eps w_k = eps g(N) below
the margin. Since g(N) is decreasing in N with g(10) = 1.90983 and the
margin exceeds kappa/4 for every N, the N-FREE sufficient condition is
   eps < kappa / (4 g(10)) ,  for which  eps < 1/8  suffices on all N >= 10
(indeed eps g(10) <= 0.23873 < 0.25 <= margin). The operative design scale
eps = 0.05 [lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:109-110] is far inside. The exact
cell-wise cap is eps < ((7/8)(S_k - m_k) + kappa/4)/g(N) = 0.45121 at
N = 10, rising to 9.48 at N = 100.

DELTA SMALLNESS CONDITION, DISPLAYED. With h = delta/2, (B1) reduces to
   Gamma_orb(delta/2) + C_2^eps (5/4) delta^2 + L_eps N delta^2/16
       <  (7/8)(S_k - m_k) + kappa/4 - eps g(N),
whose right side is 0.86174 - 0.09549 = 0.76625 at the flagship
(N, kappa, lambda, eps) = (10, 1, 1, 0.05). Since the left side is O(delta)
and beta-free, the condition is satisfiable and is COMPATIBLE WITH THE
DECLARED ORDER OF LIMITS (beta -> infinity FIRST at fixed
(eps, delta, h = delta/2), then delta, h -> 0)
[lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3121-3127]. The beta^{-N} floor cost of the
minorization enters the exponent as (N log beta)/beta -> 0, the same
err-class as PE.2(a)'s Laplace prefactor
[lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md, (ERR)].

(B2) CLOSED FORM, quoted from ADJ-2 and re-derived: "m_1 - c_H/2 =
lambda g(N) - (1/8)( g(N) + 2 - S_k ) = g(N)( lambda - 1/8 ) +
( S_k - 2 )/8" [lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:730], both summands strictly
positive for N >= 10, lambda >= 1 (g(N) > 0; S_k > 2 by the v16 ladder /
CF2, [lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:731]). Value 1.74722 at (N, lambda) =
(10, 1). The eps shift for this leg is handled by R3-STRAT's
GAP-R3STRAT-EPSWINDOW (sufficient N-free condition eps < lambda - 1/8),
which I inherit and do not re-open.

NET. min over the two legs of (exponent - c_H/2) is, in closed form,
   min{ (7/8)(S_k - m_k) + kappa/4 ,  g(N)(lambda - 1/8) + (S_k - 2)/8 }
       - eps g(N) - err(delta),
strictly positive on the WHOLE flagship range N >= 10, lambda >= kappa = 1,
eps < 1/8, delta below the explicit threshold. At the flagship the two
legs are 0.86174 and 1.74722, so the doorway leg binds, with slack
0.76625 after the eps shift. THE ARITHMETIC IS SHOWN, as the spec
demands, and the binding margin is the ADJ-2 one.

NO AGGREGATE/PER-ROUND CONFLATION. Everything above is PER ROUND on
OBJECT-R5a. The geometric count E[N] ~ 1/p and the Wald tower live at
R5a §7 [:3105-3117] and are NOT consumed (C3); no exp(beta(S_k - m_k))
factor appears anywhere in this piece. The exponent I carry is the
per-round doorway exponent S_k + c_H - m_k, not the aggregate c_H.

========================================================================
7. THE OBSTRUCTION, STATED EXACTLY (this is the honest content)
========================================================================
7.1 HYPOTHESIS (H3) OF LEMMA 6.5 IS FALSE ON R5a's TERMINUS. On
{T > t_0} with theta^+(0) <= t_0, the definition
D(0) = inf{s >= theta^+(0) : X_s in S} [:3016] FORCES X_{t_0} not in S.
So the residual mass (1-c) after one window is, by construction, carried
OFF S - it can sit anywhere the round has reached, including the
G_{k,j} pinning tori, which the ROW itself flags: "the G_{k,j} =
C_k x C_j^phi pinning tori (E_eps-critical for EVERY eps, at reachable
levels for admissible lambda) are REAL traps in the excursion region"
[lane-lp-product-saddle-v1.md:226-229]. Consequently the inequality
"u(x) <= A + c U_nu + (1-c) sup_S u" is NOT available on this object, and
the design's candidate route - "the L1' pointwise minorization gives
every start's one-step law a density floor against Leb|_S, transferring
the averaged bound to a pointwise one at an exp(beta O(h^2)) cost; the
transfer must be proved on R5a's terminus, not asserted"
[lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:92-96] - does not close as written. This is
precisely the clause "must be proved on R5a's terminus, not asserted"
doing its work: the terminus is what breaks it.

7.2 A SECOND, INDEPENDENT STRUCTURAL BLOCK. The delayed-return chain
{X_{sigma_j}} is a chain on S whose steps are FIRST S-entrances after a
collar excursion; by path continuity X_{sigma_j} lies on the topological
BOUNDARY of S almost surely. Hence its stationary (Palm) entrance law is
carried by boundary-S, a Lebesgue-null set of M. NO minorization of the
form (chain kernel) >= c Leb|_S can therefore hold for it, and no
comparison of that entrance law with L1'/M3-GS Lebesgue densities is
possible. Any transfer that routes through the delayed entrance law needs
a minorization against a measure carried by boundary-S, which is not in
the allowed list.

7.3 WHAT CRUDE ROUTES COST, AND WHY THEY FAIL. Splitting (REN) by whether
the doorway was reached gives
   sup_S u  <=  sup_S P(tau_lev <= t_0) . sup_M u  +  (residual),
and sup_M u over the winding-k sector is governed by the trap dwell,
whose exponent is gate - floor = lambda(2 - g(N))
[lane-prodexc-design-v1.md, ADJ-2 §0]. At (N, lambda) = (10,1) that is
0.09022, comfortably inside the 0.86174 doorway margin; but it GROWS
linearly in lambda while the doorway margin is lambda-free, so this crude
product FAILS for lambda >= 2 - and in any case an UPPER bound on the trap
dwell is not in the allowed list (SR-T2/SR-T3 are LOWER halves). This is
the quantitative reason the Gibbs/occupation-identity route is not a
convenience but a necessity, and it is why R3-ASM's Palm input is
load-bearing.

7.4 THE ALTERNATIVE THE SPEC-LENS OFFERS, AND ITS EXACT RESIDUE. The
stationarity domination E_mu[ integral_0^{t} 1_B ] <= K t rho_beta(B)
whenever dmu/drho_beta <= K is TRUE and COND-free (it needs only
invariance of rho_beta, established in SR-PE1 ROW SR-PE1.2, plus the
Markov property; no Palm calculus and no entrance-law comparison). I
adopt it as the reference-comparison device, which RETIRES the
Leb-to-Palm leg entirely: my route never forms a Lebesgue-averaged
occupation and never compares it to a Palm average. But the domination
carries a DETERMINISTIC horizon t; the round terminus T is random and
unbounded, so converting it into a per-round statement needs a round-length
control. That control is exactly GAP-PE3P-ROUNDLEN below.

7.5 THE EXACT REMAINING BURDEN, IN ONE LINE. Everything above reduces
(COND*) to the single scalar inequality
   sup_{x in S} P_x( tau_lev < T )  .  sup_{z in Door} W(z)
        <=  T_row exp(-beta(c_H/2 - err)),
   Door := { E_eps = S_k + c_H, w_theta = k, w_phi = 0 },
by Lemma PE3p.2(iii), Lemma PE3p.3 and strong Markov at tau_lev (on
{tau_lev < T} one has tau_lev >= theta^+(0), so the residual terminus is
H_S wedge L and the residual functional is exactly W). The first factor is
a per-round doorway-crossing probability; the second is a pure EXCURSION
cost shared verbatim by the Palm cycle and the R5a round - the two objects
funnel through the SAME interface Door. This factorisation is the piece's
structural deliverable: it isolates the entire residual burden into two
named objects on one interface, and it is what a closing round should
attack.

8. HOUSE-RULE COMPLIANCE STATEMENT
========================================================================
Exact stopping objects: four are named and never conflated - the Palm
PLAIN cycle (OBJECT-PE1, lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1936-1941), the Palm
DELAYED cycle (R3-ASM's object), the R5a round min(D(0), L)
[lane-minmig:3048], and the plain S-hitting H_S used inside W. Every
conditional expectation names its sigma-field (F_{sigma_{i-1}} in §3,
F_t in Lemma PE3p.2(ii), F_{tau_lev} in §7.5). No independence claim is
made anywhere; only strong Markov equalities of conditional laws
[lane-minmig:3064-3069] and pointwise bounds. Classical imports are NAMED
with hypothesis rows and not reproduced (SR-ITO, SR-OST in I22; SR-PE1 as
imported by that piece). No aggregate/per-round conflation: E[N] and the
Wald tower are NOT consumed. No physics vocabulary is used. The one place
where the spec's own display had to be corrected (the ridge-law level
S_k -> phi_k(pi)) is recorded with its arithmetic in §5.4 rather than
silently used.

### PE3p round 3 — typed gaps

GAP-PE3P-TRANSFER (THE LOAD-BEARING RESIDUE; owned by this piece, NOT closed; this is what remains of DELTA-PE1-ENTRANCE after Lemma PE3p.1). EXACT REQUIRED STRENGTH: a bound on the residual term of (REN) that is uniform over starts in S, i.e. either
  (T-a) a set K and a constant c > 0 with (i) P_y(X_{t_0} in .) >= c nu(.) for all y in K, nu a probability on S, and (ii) X_{t_0} in K a.s. on {T > t_0} for every start x in S, TOGETHER WITH a bound on sup_K u; or
  (T-b) an UPPER comparison of the time-t_0 law from x in S against a reference measure ON THE REGION WHERE u IS LARGE, of the form P_x(X_{t_0} in B) <= K nu(B) for Borel B contained in the complement of R_0 and the trap stratum, with K exp(beta O(delta)) at worst.
WHY IT IS NOT AVAILABLE FROM THE ALLOWED LIST: (i) hypothesis (ii) of (T-a) with K = S is FALSE by construction — on {T > t_0} with theta^+(0) <= t_0 the definition D(0) = inf{s >= theta^+(0) : X_s in S} (lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3016) forces X_{t_0} not in S, so the (1-c) residual mass sits off S, in particular possibly on the G_{k,j} pinning tori that the ROW itself calls "REAL traps in the excursion region" (lane-lp-product-saddle-v1.md:226-229); (ii) every allowed source (L1, L1' at lane-sh2local:276, L2 at :610-612, M5-MAIN at lane-minmig:1425, M3-GS at :739-741) is a LOWER bound / density FLOOR, and the two FW tools in the corpus (SR-T2, lane-c-exit-time-lower-bound-v1.md:51-96; SR-T3, lane-c-sector-persistence-readout-theorem-v1.md:30-51) are LOWER halves, so (T-b) has no source. This is the same interface defect the spec-lens identified for the first-unit charge, here recurring on the transfer leg; the first-unit charge itself is CLOSED in §5 without any such source. CONSEQUENCE: the design's candidate route (lane-prodexc-design-v1.md:92-96) does not close as written on R5a's terminus, and the one-step renewal inequality "u <= A + c U_nu + (1-c) sup_S u" is not valid on this object. TYPED, NOT ASSERTED.

GAP-PE3P-ROUNDLEN (the second named residue; the reduction of §7.5 to a probability). EXACT REQUIRED STRENGTH: sup_{x in S} P_x(tau_lev < T) <= C(eps,delta) exp(-beta(S_k + c_H - m_k - err)), with tau_lev the doorway-level hitting time and T = min(D(0), L) — i.e. the FIRST-WINDOW bound (FW-S) of §5 extended from the deterministic window [0,t_0] to the whole round. WHAT WOULD CLOSE IT, THREE NAMED ROUTES: (R1) a within-R_0 round-length control uniform over starts in S. THIS ALREADY EXISTS, PROVED AND COND-FREE, at lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3078 (the within-R_0 half of R5a (D): "Within-R_0 part (PROVED here, pointwise) ... the within-R_0 expected round duration is <= T_1(eps,delta) exp( beta( Gamma(h) + gamma_2 eps^2 + err(delta) ) )", whose own inputs are LP.2/LP.4(ii), M5.5b, L1' and LP.4(ii)(2) — none of them touches PROD-EXCURSION). It is unavailable to me ONLY because the round-3 DAG discipline forbids consuming the (D) block, and (D)'s OTHER half at :3079 does consume the target row. RECOMMENDED LEAD EDIT (one line, no new mathematics): split R5a §5(D) into (D-in) [:3078, COND-free] and (D-off) [:3079, consumes the target row]; (D-in) then becomes an admissible INPUT and this gap closes by citation. (R2) a capacity / Dirichlet-form estimate for the reversible generator on R_0 with the Gibbs weight, bounding the harmonic function P_x(hit Door before S) — COND-free but a genuinely new (if elementary) analytic import. DELTA-PE1-ENTRANCE (inherited from SR-PE1 round 2, lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1959-1980; PARTIALLY CLOSED, re-typed). CLOSED PART: the "conditional on F_{sigma_{i-1}}" half is discharged outright by Lemma PE3p.1 — the round occupation functional is a Borel function of the start point alone, so the strong-Markov template at lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3064-3066 gives E( . | F_{sigma_{i-1}} ) = u(X_{sigma_{i-1}}) a.s. with no analytic cost. That is GAP-PE3P-TRANSFER + GAP-PE3P-ROUNDLEN. The delta is therefore not closed, but it is strictly sharpened: it is now one supremum on one object, not a passage between two modes of conditioning.

DELTA-PE1-DELAYED (inherited, lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1981-1999; DISPOSED OF ON MY LEGS, INHERITED ON THE ASM LEG). Every object in §§3-6 is the DELAYED terminus min(D(0), L) (lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3048); no plain S-return cycle appears on any leg I prove, so the plain-vs-delayed delta does not arise there. It survives EXACTLY where R3-ASM's Palm input is consumed: if R3-ASM states its bound on the PLAIN Palm cycle (OBJECT-PE1, :1936-1941) rather than on the delayed-return regeneration {D(sigma_{i-1})} with its own Palm entrance law and intensity lambda_S^{delayed}, the delta is live at R3-ASM's interface and I inherit it verbatim without re-deriving. I append NO uniformity qualifier and make NO claim that the delayed cycle IS the R5a round; only the one-way truncation T_i = min(D(sigma_{i-1}), L_i) <= D(sigma_{i-1}) is used, and it is DERIVED (Lemma PE3p.2(iii)), not consumed from PE.4.

GAP-PE3-REF-TO-PALM (RETIRED AS UNNEEDED, honestly re-typed). My route forms NO Lebesgue-averaged occupation and performs NO Leb-to-Palm entrance-law comparison, so the leg the round-1/2 design asked for does not occur. Where a reference comparison is needed I adopt the spec-lens's stationarity domination E_mu[int_0^t 1_B] <= K t rho_beta(B) for dmu/drho_beta <= K, which is COND-free (it uses only invariance of rho_beta, established at SR-PE1 ROW SR-PE1.2, lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1836-1866, plus the Markov property) and needs neither Palm calculus nor an entrance-law comparison. It is NOT "closed by substitution", because it carries a DETERMINISTIC horizon and the round terminus is random and unbounded; the residue is exactly GAP-PE3P-ROUNDLEN. RECORDED ADDITIONALLY, as a structural finding: the delayed-return chain's entrance law is carried by the topological boundary of S (path continuity + first entrance), a Lebesgue-null set, so NO minorization of that chain against Leb|_S can ever hold — any future Leb-to-Palm route must minorize against a measure carried by boundary-S, which is not in the allowed list.

GAP-PE3P-ASSEMBLY (the re-typing of GAP-PE-ASSEMBLY; interface to R3-ASM). EXACT SHAPE OF THE SUM I would assemble once GAP-PE3P-TRANSFER and GAP-PE3P-ROUNDLEN close: outside-R_0 = B_out (the level region, PE.2(a) round 1 SOUND, exponent S_k + c_H - m_k - err) UNION {w_phi != 0} (R3-STRAT's stratum, exponent m_1(lambda) - err), the union taken with no double counting because the two sets are disjoint by the definition of R_0 (lane-lp:216-217) once the level region is intersected with {w_phi = 0}. WHAT IS NOT DISCHARGED HERE: the Delta_theta boundary stratum, inherited from R3-STRAT's GAP-R3STRAT-DELTATHETA (the null-mass route, plus the observation that a Delta_theta hit terminates the round rather than contributing outside time — the latter is PROVED here in Lemma PE3p.3 and can be substituted into R3-STRAT's gap, retiring its level-route worry); and R3-STRAT's GAP-R3STRAT-DENNEW denominator substitution, which R3-ASM must honor in the doorway leg (PE.2(a)'s (DEN), lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:637, must NOT be used there).

2. STANDING OBJECTS (named once; never conflated)
========================================================================
Setting, verbatim: "dX_t = -grad E_eps(X_t) dt + sqrt(2/beta) dW_t on
M = T^{2N}, flagship k=1, N>=10, M2-PIN (lambda>kappa), eps in [0, eps_2)
fixed" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3001]. Generator L = (1/beta) Delta -
grad E_eps . grad, reversible for the Gibbs measure rho_beta (SR-PE1 ROW
SR-PE1.2, lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1855-1885).

Balls, verbatim: "S := B_{delta/4}(g*)" [:3008]; "S^+ := B_{delta/2}(g*)
(= B_h(g*) - the exit collar), S subset S^+ subset U_ch" [:3009], h = delta/2,
max norm [lane-lp:93-101].

Filtration, verbatim: "Let (F_t)_{t>=0} be the augmented natural filtration of
the diffusion X, F_t := sigma(X_{s} : s <= t) completed and made
right-continuous. ... theta^+(.), D(.), the sigma_i, and the crossing time (§4)
are all hitting times of Borel sets by the continuous process X, hence
(F_t)-stopping times; F_{sigma_{i-1}} is the corresponding stopped sigma-field.
Because the SDE is autonomous, the strong Markov property holds at each
sigma_{i-1}." [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3035].

Stopping objects: theta^+(t) := inf{s >= t : X_s not in S^+};
D(t) := inf{s >= theta^+(t) : X_s in S} [:3015-3016];
L_i := inf{s > sigma_{i-1} : w_theta(X_s) != k} [:3044];
T_i := min(D(sigma_{i-1}), L_i) [:3048]. Round-start law, verbatim: "There is
no fixed regeneration law nu here: X_{sigma_{i-1}} is an arbitrary
(F_{sigma_{i-1}}-measurable) point of S" [:3037].

FOUR OBJECTS, NEVER CONFLATED. O_pl = the PLAIN Palm S-return cycle
(OBJECT-PE1, [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:1955-1957]), expectation E_Palm^{pl};
O_del = the DELAYED Palm cycle on {D(sigma_{i-1})} with its own entrance law
and intensity lambda_S^{delayed}, expectation E_Palm^{del}; O_R5a = the R5a
round [sigma_{i-1}, T_i); and H_S = the plain S-hitting time used inside the
post-collar functional. No E_Palm appears below without a superscript.

THE ROUND FUNCTIONAL. For y in M, on the path started at y with D(0), L,
T := min(D(0), L) read from the shifted origin,
   u(y) := E_y[ integral_0^{T} 1_{M \ R_0}(X_s) ds ]   in [0, infinity].
This is the R5a DELAYED ROUND object O_R5a; it is neither O_pl nor O_del.

3. (PE3p.1) THE REDUCTION: THE CONDITIONAL ROW IS EXACTLY A SUPREMUM
========================================================================
LEMMA PE3p.1. For every i >= 1, on O_R5a,
   E( integral_{sigma_{i-1}}^{T_i} 1_{M \ R_0}(X_s) ds | F_{sigma_{i-1}} )
        = u( X_{sigma_{i-1}} )        a.s.,
and ROW PROD-EXCURSION-COND holds at strength T_row exp(-beta(c_H/2 - err)) for
EVERY admissible round-start field and EVERY F_{sigma_{i-1}}-measurable start in
S IF AND ONLY IF
   sup_{x in S} u(x) <= T_row(eps,delta) exp( -beta( c_H/2 - err(delta) ) ).
                                                                     (COND*)
PROOF. The occupation functional integral_0^{T} 1_{M\R_0}(X_s) ds is a
non-negative Borel functional of the POST-sigma_{i-1} path alone (T is read from
the shifted origin), so u is a Borel function of the start point alone - the
same status R5a records for Phi and Psi, verbatim "Phi, Psi are Borel functions
of the START POINT alone (functionals of the post-start path law P_x). By the
strong Markov property at sigma_{i-1} (§3), the regular conditional law of the
post-sigma_{i-1} path given F_{sigma_{i-1}} is P_{X_{sigma_{i-1}}}, evaluated at
the F_{sigma_{i-1}}-measurable random variable X_{sigma_{i-1}}"
[lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3064]. The displayed identity is that template read
for u in place of Phi, exactly as R5a reads it for Phi at "P( round i crosses |
F_{sigma_{i-1}} ) = Phi( X_{sigma_{i-1}} )      a.s." [:3066]. Non-negativity
gives the conditional expectation without integrability hypotheses. Since
X_{sigma_{i-1}} ranges over S and is otherwise arbitrary [:3037], the a.s.
uniform conditional bound is EQUIVALENT to (COND*). QED.

NO INDEPENDENCE IS CLAIMED. The conditioning field is the pre-sigma_{i-1} path
field; the functional is post-sigma_{i-1}; the only fact used is the
strong-Markov equality of conditional laws, verbatim as R5a states it at :3069.

CONSEQUENCE. The conditioning half of DELTA-PE1-ENTRANCE is discharged outright:
the passage from an averaged statement to an a.s. statement conditional on
F_{sigma_{i-1}} is not an analytic burden once the functional is recognised as
start-point-measurable. The ENTIRE analytic burden is the UNIFORMITY over S.

4. (PE3p.2) THE ROUND FUNCTIONAL ON M; THE DELAYED-RETURN DOMINATION;
   THE COLLAR LEMMA (MAJOR-3 CURED)
========================================================================
LEMMA PE3p.2. Let x in M, t >= 0. Then a.s.
 (i)   D(t) >= D(0) whenever t <= D(0);
 (ii)  on {T > t}, E( integral_t^{T} 1_{M\R_0}(X_s) ds | F_t ) <= u(X_t);
 (iii) (COLLAR LEMMA) for every x in S,
          u(x) = E_x[ W( X_{theta^+(0)} ) ],
       W(z) := E_z[ integral_0^{H_S wedge L} 1_{M\R_0}(X_s) ds ],
       H_S := inf{s >= 0 : X_s in S};
       i.e. the pre-collar-exit stretch contributes NOTHING.

PROOF. (i) Three cases off the definitions [:3015-3016]. If theta^+(0) > t then
X_t in S^+ and theta^+(t) = theta^+(0), so D(t) = D(0). If theta^+(0) <= t and
X_t not in S^+, then theta^+(t) = t and D(t) = inf{s >= t : X_s in S} = D(0),
because no S-entrance occurred on [theta^+(0), t] (t < D(0)). If theta^+(0) <= t
and X_t in S^+ \ S, then theta^+(t) >= t is the NEXT collar exit and D(t) the
first S-entrance after it, so D(t) >= D(0). (The sub-case X_t in S is vacuous
under t < D(0).)
(ii) On {T > t} the label has not changed, so L read from t equals L; by (i) the
terminus read from t is >= T. Markov at the deterministic t (autonomy, :3035)
plus non-negativity of the integrand give the inequality.
(iii) THE COLLAR FACT, RE-BASED (this is the repair). I must show
S^+ subset R_0 and L > theta^+(0). Three components, each from a GROUND-collar
source:
 (a) w_theta = k on S^+ and on [0, theta^+(0)]. VERBATIM from R5a §1:
     "Because S^+ subset U_ch subset the winding-k ground tube, which misses
     Delta_theta by level ... the theta-label is constantly k on
     [t, theta^+(t)]: any theta-label change is strictly later than
     theta^+(t)" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:3018]. The underlying geometry is
     M2P.5 Step 3, verbatim "keeps the trajectory in the winding-k sector
     D_k(eps) with both Delta faces missed" [lane-minmig-proofs-v1.md:796-798].
     This also gives L > theta^+(0) always.
 (b) w_phi = 0 on S^+. ELEMENTARY, and stated so rather than cited: g* lies on
     G_k = C_k^theta x C_0^phi, so every phi-bond vanishes at g*; on the max-norm
     ball B_{delta/2}(g*) each phi-coordinate moves by at most delta/2, hence
     each phi-bond e_i satisfies |e_i| <= delta < pi for delta < pi, so S^+
     misses Delta_phi (a Delta_phi point has some |e_i| = pi). S^+ is connected
     and contains g*, and w_phi "is well defined and locally constant off
     `Delta`" [la3-reader-packet-v1.md:55-56]; therefore w_phi == 0 on S^+.
 (c) E_eps <= S_k + c_H on S^+. By (UP-QUAD) "E_eps(x) <= m_k + eps w_k +
     (L_eps/2) dist(x, G_k)^2   on U" [lane-prodexc-proofs-v1.md:620], valid on
     the GROUND tube U = T_{r0}(G_k) [lane-minmig:1375-1376], applicable because
     delta/2 <= r0. With the corpus max-norm convention [lane-lp:93-101] and the
     one-way conversion dist_euc <= sqrt(2N) dist_max, on S^+ we get
     dist_euc <= sqrt(2N) delta/2 and hence
        sup_{S^+} E_eps  <=  m_k + eps w_k + L_eps N delta^2/4 .   (E-TOP+)
     THE THRESHOLD, AT THE CORRECT RADIUS (the factor-of-4 repair):
        L_eps N delta^2/4  <  S_k + c_H - m_k - eps w_k ,           (THR)
     whose right side is 0.928859 at the flagship (N, kappa, lambda, eps) =
     (10, 1, 1, 0.05). (THR) is a delta-smallness condition at fixed N and is
     compatible with the mandated order of limits [lane-minmig:3125].
 Under (a)-(c), S^+ subset R_0, so no outside-R_0 time accrues on
 [0, theta^+(0)]. Also D(0) > theta^+(0) strictly and there are no zero-time
 returns, verbatim "every delayed return carries a genuine excursion of radial
 extent >= delta/4, and D(t) > t strictly. There are NO trivial zero-time
 returns" [lane-minmig:3018]. After theta^+(0) the terminus min(D(0), L) equals
 H_S wedge L read from theta^+(0). Strong Markov at theta^+(0) (a stopping
 time, :3035) gives (iii). QED.

WHAT CHANGED FROM ROUND 3, EXPLICITLY. The round-3 proof of (iii) invoked
"[phi] ... T_{r_0'} misses Delta_phi by level ..." and "[theta] ... T_{r_0'}
